exceptions.rationale: No patched release. The inspected service uses ssh-key RSA public signature verification and private-key parsing, pins gateway JWT verification to Ed25519, and delegates KMS private operations upstream. No local RustCrypto RSA private-decryption call was identified. Keep RSA SSH verification; reassess changes to crypto call paths or features. See docs/security-evidence.md.

imageExceptions.rationale: Explicit maintainer acceptance while the severity discrepancy is investigated. The scanner reports HIGH; glibc upstream scores this issue 3.7 (low), and Debian marks trixie no-DSA/minor with no fixed package listed. Application reachability is not established. Keep the maintained glibc runtime and complete scan evidence; reassess when the package changes or this exception expires. Sources: https://sourceware.org/pipermail/libc-announce/2026/000068.html and https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-100290
